methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Offered responses were "Yes" (2 points), "No" (0 points) or "Partially" (1 point). Points for all responses were totaled to calculate the results. The results were used to calculate the energy management implementation level.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Questionnaire-based assessment of energy-management-system implementation without an EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: In this study, the model for assessing energy management implementation is not the same as in the above-mentioned studies, making the data useful only for approximate comparisons

stage1.notes: The paper assesses EnMS implementation maturity; it does not identify or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model.
